title: Global runnable queue current item count
summary: Changed live queue progress metadata so Current Item can show global runnable queue position across priority, movie, TV, and low-priority phases while preserving bucket-local queue fields for Queue table evidence.
reason: The operator needs the Home Current Item card to show progress through the full runnable pipeline plan, not just the active phase bucket.
behavior_before: CurrentQueueIndex and CurrentQueueTotal were populated from each phase bucket, so the Home Current Item metric reset when processing moved from high priority to normal movie, TV, or low-priority phases.
behavior_after: Queue snapshot construction annotates runnable entries with RunQueueIndex and RunQueueTotal after exclusion checks; serial and local-worker progress use those run-level values while bucket QueueIndex and QueueTotal remain available for table/context evidence.
